uncited: **Extract Slice Plane:** Determine the geometric plane intersecting the 3D volume.

**Calculate Intensity:** Convert the sampled scalar values to grayscale using window/level mapping: $grey = \text{clip}\left(\frac{plane - (level - window / 2)}{window} \times 255, 0, 255\right)$, cast to `uint8`.
**Blend Segmentation Layers:** For each visible layer, extract its 2D mask slice.
